_comment: DESIGN.md v3.2 §6 and §10.5. Frozen at tag freeze-design; the report script reads k rules, ranking, CI settings and verdict rules only from this file and fails if its sha256 differs from configs/frozen_hashes.json.

rank: abs(mean beta over all 50 subsamples, zeros included) desc

EN-pred.method: hierarchical stability elastic net (DESIGN §4.1); = MD-pure; never reads observed effects (NaN mask only)
rank: abs(mean beta over all 50 subsamples, zeros included) desc

universe: identical (g, d) universe U for all arms: g eligible (U_ctrl genes excluded), d in 𝒟_g minus self-null meeting DESIGN §3 counts; features of one g in one variant group de-duplicated to the best-ranked member before any top-k

P1_primary.question: Q2
P1_primary.candidate_pool: (g, d) in U_G, not F2 (own EXPDOSE), R-evaluable (design_params replication_s6.R_evaluable) and R power >= 0.5
P1_primary.k_rule: k_G = min(100, floor(|Pool_G| / 3)), computed and committed in results/benchmark/p1_pool.json before freeze-catalogue
P1_primary.power: design_params replication_s6.power_formula on EB-shrunk standardised D effect; identical for all arms; committed before freeze-catalogue
P1_primary.replicated: same sign as D AND one-sided p < 0.05 in R (confounder model, same covariate drops, CR2 + nu)

ci.method: paired bootstrap over R lines grouped by PatientID; lists, drops and pool fixed; tests refitted; rules in design_params replication_s6.bootstrap_rules

claim_rules.beyond_inputs: 'the predictor finds determinants beyond its hand-coded inputs' only if the predictor_adds_value contrast computed within the non_direct stratum (potentially-direct, expression-derived, proxy) has CI lower bound > 0
claim_rules.beyond_any_input: 'beyond any predictor input' only from the proxy access class, same rule

secondary_variants: top-k over all U (non-evaluable counted as not replicated)
gene-matched: at most 2 features per gene
list-level: sign concordance (binomial vs 0.5), Deming slope beta_R on beta_D, observed/expected replications
P1_primary.strata_rule: re-rank within Pool_G ∩ stratum; k_s = min(100, floor(|Pool_s|/3)), committed in p1_pool.json; same bootstrap and branches
P1_primary.below_min: descriptive (underpowered: k); no claim; applies to k_G and every k_s (incl. proxy for beyond_any_input)
P1_primary.en_zero_freq: rows with selection_freq = 0 are not rankable; if fewer than k remain, the list is shorter and n_list is reported

XLIB_secondary.question: Q2 (secondary)
XLIB_secondary.discovery: D lines whose library string is exactly 'Avana' (own lambda CV, same params)
XLIB_secondary.replication: D lines with no Avana in the library string
XLIB_secondary.rules: as P1 (U_G pool, k rule, power from discovery-set shrunk effects, bootstrap over replication-set patients)
XLIB_secondary.caveat: U and eligibility were selected on all-D effects, so absolute XLIB rates are optimistic; u_rule = discovery_only recomputes eligibility on discovery lines (no refit). Pred arms are not run on XLIB (their OOF predictions were trained on replication-line effects).

P2_primary_clinical.question: Q4a
P2_primary_clinical.statistic: recall of testable S/W CGT tests (partitions sensitivity + bypass-resistance; ko_class concordant, concordant-family, concordant-KO/combination-required)
P2_primary_clinical.hit: g in target set T and rank_of_feature_D <= k, any sign
P2_primary_clinical.below_min: P2 reported as 'descriptive (underpowered: n testable tests)'; p2_status = descriptive
P2_primary_clinical.direction_accuracy: separate: hits with pre-registered sign / all hits

sets.non_proxy: headline: tests with proxy = 0 (ALLELE features for allele-defined tests)
sets.incl_proxy: secondary: adds HOT:<gene> proxy copies (proxy = 1); never pooled with the headline
sets.gate_disjoint: tests not in configs/positive_controls.csv; headline whenever results/gate_iterations.csv has more than one row

also_reported: miss_decomposition per arm (design_params clinical_s10.miss_decomposition), summing to the misses
P2_primary_clinical.rank_of_feature_D: 1 + number of rows of the arm's de-duplicated U_all ranking, excluding (g, variant group of feature_D), whose rank_stat is better than feature_D's own rank_stat; hit iff rank_of_feature_D <= k and g in T. The group's best member never lends its rank (no proxying).

everything_else: secondary; REPORT.md labels it as such
report_opening: three case studies = top three shortlist rows
wording_rules: MSI->WRN and MTAP->PRMT5/MAT2A recovery is 'recovered, also used as a pipeline gate', never 'independent validation'
'not in curated lists', never 'novel', for shortlist genes
